findings.evidence: The paper describes 5-fold cross-validation over the training data, but the script trains 5 folds per seed and then predicts the test set with the model left over from the last fold only (predictions = model.predict(X_test) after the fold loop), so the reported test metrics come from one fold's model, not from an ensemble or from all folds.
findings.question_for_authors: Which fold's model produced the reported test metrics, and were the test metrics averaged over folds?

findings.location: Introduction p.2 and Methods p.7 vs SI Table S2
findings.evidence: The paper says the training data are laboratory-scale biofilters and the test data are a full-scale operational biofilter, but SI Table S2 describes the test set as five laboratory-scale biofilters at 10 and 20 C (the Shi et al. study), and the Methods themselves say the 62 test samples come from that laboratory temperature-gradient study. The cross-scale generalisation claim is not supported by the described split.
findings.question_for_authors: Is the 62-sample test set from a full-scale or a laboratory-scale biofilter?

findings.location: Results p.5 vs Supplementary Methods (SHAP Analysis Setup)
findings.evidence: Results say SHAP was performed 'using a Ridge regression model with Buckingham Pi features'; the Supplementary Methods say shap.Explainer was applied to a trained GradientBoostingRegressor (gb_model), and Figs. S4/S5 captions name the Gradient Boosting Regressor. The model behind the SHAP values is described two ways.
findings.question_for_authors: Was the SHAP analysis run on the Ridge or the Gradient Boosting model?

findings.location: Methods p.9 and Table S4 vs code/R2_FeedBi_N.py:137-146
findings.evidence: Table S4 states early stopping with patience 10 epochs; the released create_model/fit calls use no EarlyStopping callback (model.fit(..., epochs=n_epochs, batch_size=batch, validation_data=...)), and the Dropout layer is commented out although Table S4 lists dropout 0.1.
findings.question_for_authors: Was early stopping and dropout used in the runs behind Tables 1-2?

findings.location: SI Table S2 vs capsule data/test_data.csv
findings.evidence: SI Table S2 gives the test-set ranges T [10,20], Pz 0.1, A [70,340], Bt 180, P 1.058, Cfit 2.6, t0 37, ICorg [7.725,21.7], ECorg [5.291,17.25]; the released data/test_data.csv (62 rows) reproduces every one of these ranges (T 10-20, Pv 0.1, A 70-340, Bt 180, P 1.058, Cfit 2.6, ICorg 7.724-21.7, ECorg 5.291-17.25). The test set is therefore a single-condition laboratory set (one pore size, one particle size, one filter diameter, one contact time), not a full-scale operational biofilter as the Introduction states.
findings.question_for_authors: Which biofilter produced the 62 test observations, and is it full-scale?

findings.evidence: Table 1 gives BP-NN training R2 0.95 (0.005) and Table 2 training sMAPE 2 (0.1); Supplementary Table S5 gives the same EnviroPiNet model train R2 0.94 and train sMAPE 2.1, and test sMAPE 5.6 where Table 2 gives 6 (2.1). The test R2 agrees (0.9). The ablation table and the main tables describe the same model on the same data, so the training values differ by more than rounding.
findings.question_for_authors: Were Table 1/2 and Table S5 produced by the same run? Which training R2 and sMAPE belong to the reported EnviroPiNet?

findings.evidence: Table S4 lists learning rate 0.05 and 200 epochs; the released training script sets learning_rate = 0.0001 (line 61) and n_epochs = 50 (line 65). Batch size 16, 64 units, 3 layers, ReLU, L2 0.01, dropout 0.1 and 7 seeds agree.

findings.evidence: The 5-fold KFold in the training loop splits the 255 training rows at random, but the rows are time series from three biofilters (Quinn 175 rows over 162 days, Ma 26 rows, Shi 54 rows). Rows from the same filter and adjacent sampling dates therefore sit on both sides of every fold, so the validation R2 used for model selection is not an out-of-filter estimate. The test set is a separate study, so the test metrics are not affected by this, but the training/validation numbers in Tables 1-2 are.
findings.question_for_authors: Were the cross-validation folds grouped by biofilter or by sampling date?
